reason: I might put the bot in one group to use up the free 30 and see what it does, but I won't put a card down and move all my villas' money onto a bot nobody's heard of. The way I do it now is messy, but I know it'll still work next year.
objection: Will this little bot still be around in a year? I'd be letting it into the groups where all our transfer screenshots go, and if it disappears or starts charging more once I depend on it, I'm stuck cleaning up the mess.
would_change_my_mind: Another villa operator I know telling me they've run it for a few months and it caught real duplicates or errors, so I know it works and the company is going to stick around.
